Deliveries.CashNeedsShift: Cash goes into the drawer: open a shift first, or record it as a transfer.
Deliveries.Empty: No online orders paid through a delivery company here. On the register, mark the sale as an online order and choose "Delivery company (pay later)" when paying.
Deliveries.Over: {0} more than owed. The difference is recorded.
Deliveries.OwedHint: Money collected from customers that hasn't reached the store yet. Click a company to see its orders.
Deliveries.SelectHint: Select the orders the company paid for (Ctrl or Shift + click).
Deliveries.Short: {0} less than owed (e.g. the company kept its fee). The difference is recorded.
